## Repeat this review manually

Run `npm run research:review -- --as-of YYYY-MM-DD`. Open changed, stale and deadline-sensitive primary sources in Chrome. Inspect the full description and application availability; keep closed and pipeline listings distinctly labeled. Update source facts, review date, restrictions and availability only from observed evidence, then regenerate this report. A successful HTTP response alone does not establish an open vacancy.

Before a release, check employer deadlines and all changed records; recheck occupational source vintages, geography, occupation codes, units and transformations when updating charts. Run `npm run check`, exercise changed browser behavior, verify deployment, and attach the commit and deployment result to the corresponding issue and [release history](../revisions/releases).

The command performs no external requests, sends no applicant information and creates no automation. Source-age thresholds are maintenance aids, not a guarantee that younger postings are current.
